### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | The atacseq --outdir: ALIGNER/merged_library/, fastqc/, trimgalore/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/, plus a MultiQC 1.31 or later parquet, either the pipeline's own under multiqc/broad_peak/multiqc_data/ or a reprocessed one under multiqc/multiqc_data/. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC assembly the run was aligned to (hg38, hg19, mm10, ...). Sets the genome axis of the Locus tab; pass --var GENOME=<assembly> for a run on another build. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`ataqv/chromosome_counts.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ataqv/chromosome_counts.py) | Reads per reference sequence, per library, from the ataqv JSON reports. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `read_count`, `fraction_of_reads`, `log10_read_count` |
| [`ataqv/fragment_length.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ataqv/fragment_length.py) | Fragment-length distribution of every ATAC library, in long form. | `sample`, `fragment_length`, `read_count`, `fraction_of_all_reads`, `fragment_class` |
| [`ataqv/metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ataqv/metrics.py) | Per-library ATAC quality metrics from the ataqv JSON reports. | `sample`, `tss_enrichment`, `total_reads`, `hqaa`, `hqaa_fraction`, `hqaa_in_peaks`, `hqaa_overlapping_peaks_percent`, `total_autosomal_reads`, `total_mitochondrial_reads`, `mitochondrial_fraction`, `duplicate_fraction`, `duplicate_fraction_in_peaks`, `duplicate_fraction_not_in_peaks`, `peak_duplicate_ratio`, `total_peaks`, `total_peak_territory`, `hqaa_tf_count`, `hqaa_mononucleosomal_count`, `short_mononucleosomal_ratio`, `max_fraction_reads_from_single_autosome`, `median_mapq`, `properly_paired_fraction`, `maximum_proper_pair_fragment_size`, `median_fragment_length`, `ataqv_version` |
| [`ataqv/tss_coverage.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ataqv/tss_coverage.py) | Coverage profile around transcription start sites, in long form. | `sample`, `position`, `coverage` |
| [`deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py) | Per-sample deepTools fingerprint metrics, one row per library. | `sample`, `auc`, `synthetic_auc`, `auc_ratio`, `x_intercept`, `synthetic_x_intercept`, `elbow_point`, `synthetic_elbow_point`, `synthetic_js_distance` |
| [`deeptools/plot_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/plot_profile.py) | deepTools metagene profile in long form, one row per sample and bin. | `sample`, `group`, `bin`, `bin_label`, `signal` |
| [`deseq2/qc_sample_dists.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deseq2/qc_sample_dists.py) | The DESeq2 QC sample-distance matrix the pipeline already computed. | `sample` |
| [`homer/annotate_peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/homer/annotate_peaks.py) | Tidy HOMER ``annotatePeaks.pl`` output into a per-peak annotation table. | `sample`, `peak_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `peak_score`, `annotation_class`, `annotation`, `distance_to_tss`, `nearest_promoter_id`, `gene_name`, `gene_type` |
| [`homer/tss_distance_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/homer/tss_distance_profile.py) | Where each sample's peaks sit relative to the nearest TSS, pre-binned. | `sample`, `distance_to_tss`, `peak_count`, `fraction` |
